column1: When enabled, orders paid with NovaPay show a single "NovaPay Refund" button in the order view, and these native buttons are hidden: Credit Memo (order view and invoice view), Void (order view) and Refund Offline (credit memo form). For a hold the button cancels the order (the hold is released at NovaPay); for a paid order it opens a refund form and creates the standard online credit memo internally. When disabled, the native Magento credit memo flow is used.

Для холду кнопка скасовує замовлення (холд знімається в NovaPay), для оплаченого замовлення відкриває форму повернення і створює стандартний онлайн credit memo. column1: When enabled, a NovaPay order in hold shows a "Confirm NovaPay Hold" button in the order view, and the standard Invoice button is hidden for NovaPay orders. The button creates the standard online invoice, which sends the hold confirmation to NovaPay. When disabled, the native Magento invoice flow is used.
